audience: supplement brand founder or marketing lead
cta: Send me the live page or campaign. I will point to one consequential message or proof gap using your public words—nothing invented.

Clearly separate marketing judgment from qualified legal or regulatory review.

measurement_hypothesis.falsifier: The page is indexed but the target cluster shows no observable impression change relative to the preserved baseline or matched untouched questions during the fixed 56-day window.
measurement_hypothesis.prediction: After approved publication and indexation, the fixed target-query cluster may produce new non-branded GSC impressions relative to the preserved baseline and matched untouched questions.

notes: Approved for this local internal prototype only. Target demand, publication, and all market effects remain untested.
risk_boundary: This is marketing and source-organization guidance, not legal, medical, regulatory, ranking, citation, traffic, or revenue advice.
